integrity: The all-dimensional result is proved algebraically from finite-group Fourier positivity; finite exact computation is corroborative only.
scientific_limitations: Only the support shell of Hamming weights zero and two is treated.
The result classifies translation-invariant positive-definite Turán extremizers, not all graph-SDP optimal matrices.
Older association-scheme literature under different terminology remains a residual originality risk.
title: Sharp Turán constant and all extremizers for the weight-two Boolean Hamming shell
